resources.string: This device has no usable Android WebView, the component DubLift needs to display its dashboard inside the app. That is why the dashboard cannot be shown here.

Install or enable Chrome or Android System WebView, then reopen DubLift. Use the button below to open the dashboard in a browser on this device. To use another device on the same LAN (Wi-Fi or Ethernet), open the LAN address shown below in its browser. Keep DubLift running on this device.
WebView could not load the dashboard or its renderer stopped. Copy the debug info below and send it to the developer to help find the cause.
Looking for this device\'s LAN dashboard address…
No LAN IP address is available. You can still use the button above on this device. Connect to Wi-Fi or Ethernet to display an address for another device.
No browser installed. Install Chrome or open the LAN address on another device on the same LAN.
